name: Mercari, Inc.
note: Tokyo-headquartered operator of the Mercari marketplace and fintech businesses; listed on the Tokyo Stock Exchange Prime Market (code 4385). Its corporate governance report of 1 October 2025 lists founder and CEO Shintaro Yamada as the largest shareholder with 22.08%, records no controlling shareholder and no parent company. Mercari group includes Kashima Antlers F.C. Co., Ltd.
